content: Kemɨranukuke
Merikɨtsɨ 'uxipiya tukari 'utaxɨku, tumikuti ximeri yuimuana Mariya Mararatanaka meta xewitɨ Mariya matɨa mana mekaniu'axɨani me'ixeiyake teukiya.
Hikɨ kwie karima kaniutayuani, taheima kanakaneni niuki tuayame Ti'aitame hetsɨa mieme, hikɨ nuaka teté kaneukɨhɨani, meta hetsiena kanayerɨni.
Merɨkariya hepaɨ pɨtiyuxexeiyakai, 'ixurikiteya pɨtuxakai 'ɨwi hepaɨ.
Tehɨwemete kuyaxi me'imakatɨ meputiyɨyɨakaxɨ meta marikakɨ mekaniu'amɨxɨani.
Hikɨ niuki tuayame mɨpaɨ katiniwarutahɨawe 'ukari: —Xepɨkamamaka, ne mɨpaɨ nepɨtimate Ketsutsi xepɨkuwautɨwe, kuruxitsie mumierie.
'Uwa pɨkayeka, panukuketɨarie kemainekai. Xekenakɨni xekeneutanenieri hakewa matekiekai.

Hikɨ kwitɨwa xekenehu, mɨpaɨ xeketeniwaretahɨawi teyɨ'ɨkitɨwametemama: “Mɨkɨ panukuketɨarie mɨkite watsata, meta petɨari Karereyatsie paitɨ. Mana xekaneixeiyakuni”. Xekena'eriwani kenemɨtixe'utahɨawixɨ.
Hikɨ 'ukarawetsixi mekanayekɨne meyumexɨitɨatɨ teukiyapa meyekɨneka, memamatɨ peru waɨkawa meyutemamawietɨ, meta mekaniutinautsa memɨtewataxatɨanikɨ teyɨ'ɨkitɨwametemama.
Hikɨ mexi me'uhukai, Ketsutsi kaniwaranukunake, hikɨ kaniwarutawaɨritɨani. Hikɨ mɨkɨ hurawa mekaniukɨne, 'ɨkateya mekaniu'ɨni meta mekaniutihɨxima'uni hɨxiena.
Hikɨ mɨpaɨ katiniwarutahɨawe Ketsutsi: —Xepɨkaheumamaka, xekenehu, xeketeniwaretaxatɨa ne'iwama Karereya mekehekɨne, mana mekanenexeiyakuni.
Kuyaxi kememutiyua
Merikɨtsɨ mexi 'ukari huyeta me'uhukai, hipatɨ kuyaxi kiekaritsie mekanekɨne, kemɨtiuyɨ naime mekateniwarutaxatɨani mawari wewiwamete tewa'aitɨwamete.
Hikɨ mɨkɨ 'ukirawetsixi wahamatɨa me'uyukuxeɨrieka me'uyu'enieka yunaitɨ, tumini waɨkawa mekaniwaru'ɨitɨani kuyaxi,
mɨpaɨ metewarahɨawetɨ: «Xeme mɨpaɨ xekeneutiyuaneni: Mexi tekutsukai, teyɨ'ɨkitɨwametemama mekaniu'axɨani mekaninawani kaxari.
Xɨka kuwexinaruri tiutamarieni, tame 'aixɨa tepɨteyurieni xehetsie mɨkarahɨiyanikɨ».
Hikɨ mɨkɨ tumini me'anu'ɨka yamekaniutiyuanekaitɨni kememɨte'uta'aitɨariekai. Mɨpaɨ tiuyɨku mɨpaɨ pɨtikuxaxatsiwa naitsarie huriyutsixi watsata hikɨ 'akuxi.
Ketsutsi kemɨtiwaruhɨritɨa nɨ'ariekate
Hikɨ teyɨ'ɨkitɨwamete tamamata heimana xewi Karereya mekanekɨne, mɨkɨ yemuritsie paitɨ Ketsutsi kemɨtiwarahɨawekai.
Me'ixeiyaka hɨxiena mekaniukatunuma'uni, peru hipatɨ mɨkɨ 'akuxi yuri mepɨkate'eriekai xɨka yuritɨkaitɨni.
Hikɨ Ketsutsi 'ahurawa kaniuyani, katiniwarutaxatɨani, mɨpaɨ 'utaitɨ: —Naimekɨ heitserie nepexeiya taheima meta kwiepa.
'Ayumieme, xekenehu, teyɨ'ɨkitɨwamete xekeniwarayeitɨa yunaime nuiwarite, xewaka'ɨyatɨ Ta'ukiyari meta Nu'aya meta 'Iyari Mɨtiyupata hetsiemieme,
xetewa'ɨkitɨatɨ yamemɨtekahunikɨ naime xeme kenemɨtixe'u'aitɨa. Yurikɨ mɨpaɨ xeketenemaika, netsietɨ tukarikɨ xehamatɨa nekaniuyeikamɨkɨ, kepaukake kwie meutipare. Mɨpaɨ xeikɨa kani'aneni.
